svg.metadata: {"version":1,"title":"括号翻转：段内镜像，后缀统一平移","steps":[{"caption":"样例原前缀曲线，准备翻转位置三到五。","image":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","duration":2100,"facts":{"phase":0,"prefix":[0,1,2,3,2,1,2,1],"oldLeft":2,"oldRight":1,"suffixShift":2}},{"caption":"先保存修改前 P[2]=2、P[5]=1。之后不能用已修改的端点代替。","image":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","duration":2100,"facts":{"phase":1,"prefix":[0,1,2,3,2,1,2,1],"oldLeft":2,"oldRight":1,"suffixShift":2}},{"caption":"段内关于基线二镜像，后缀统一加二；两段公式属于同一次操作。","image":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","duration":2100,"facts":{"phase":2,"prefix":[0,1,2,3,2,1,2,1],"oldLeft":2,"oldRight":1,"suffixShift":2}},{"caption":"按旧端点一次得到整条新曲线，前面不变，段内镜像，后缀上移。","image":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","duration":2100,"facts":{"phase":3,"prefix":[0,1,2,1,2,3,4,3],"oldLeft":2,"oldRight":1,"suffixShift":2}},{"caption":"新曲线在第三位就低于查询基线，因此无法从第三位形成合法括号段。","image":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","duration":2100,"facts":{"phase":4,"prefix":[0,1,2,1,2,3,4,3],"oldLeft":2,"oldRight":1,"suffixShift":2}}]}
